string.text: %c[255,96,160,255]Popup Messages%c[default]: X offset for pickup toasts (slider under Popup Messages, default -35). Hides the dummy-bayonet toast on knife quick melee.
Shifts pickup toasts left (negative) or right (positive) after APM's slide-in. Stock Position X is overwritten by the animation; this offset is applied after that. Default -35.
